scene_description: A giraffe leans its long neck toward two people at a zoo. An adult with a beard and a child wearing a hat are reaching their hands out toward the giraffe. There is a fence visible in the background.

questions.question: What animal is in the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the big animal with a long neck and spots.

questions.question: Who is reaching their hands toward the giraffe?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the people on the right side of the picture.

questions.question: What is the child wearing on their head?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the top of the smaller person's head.

questions.question: Where are the people and the giraffe?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the fence and the platform behind the giraffe.

questions.question: What color are the spots on the giraffe?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the pattern on the giraffe's neck and body.
